t: This is Ely Place, a gated street of tall terraces at the southern tip of Camden, next to Hatton Garden. Here you'll find Ye Olde Mitre, a pub of Tudor origin, rebuilt in 1773. The street has a connection with bishops. Edmund Keene died here. He was Master of Peterhouse, Cambridge, then Bishop of Chester, and later Bishop of Ely. Thomas Dampier also died here, and he served as Bishop of Rochester and then Bishop of Ely.
